{{Short description|Pakistani mathematician}}
'''Sohail Nadeem''' is a [[Pakistanis|Pakistani]] Professor of [[Applied mathematics|Applied Mathematics]] and Chairman of Mathematics Department at [[Quaid-i-Azam University]]. He is Fellow of the [[The World Academy of Sciences|world Academy of sciences]] and an elected Fellow of [[Pakistan Academy of Sciences]]. He is a recipient of the 2022 [[Obada Prize|Obada Prize Award]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Loop {{!}} Prof Dr. Sohail Nadeem |url=https://loop.frontiersin.org/people/148653/bio |access-date=2022-06-28 |website=loop.frontiersin.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Sohail |url=https://www.elivapress.com/en/authors/author-5240596269/ |access-date=2022-06-28 |website=www.elivapress.com}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Nadeem, Sohail |url=https://twas.org/directory/nadeem-sohail |access-date=2022-06-28 |website=TWAS |language=en}}</ref><ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=Dr. Sohail Nadeem {{!}} Department of Mathematics |url=http://math.qau.edu.pk/faculty/dr-sohail-nadeem/ |access-date=2022-06-28 |language=en-US}}</ref><ref name=":3">{{Cite web |last=Nadeem |first=Sohail |title=Curriculum vitae |url=https://twas.org/sites/default/files/cv-sohail-12-01-2021.docx |website=twas.org}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
Sohail Nadeem was born on 15 March 1975. He attended Quaid-i-Azam University, Islamabad, Pakistan from his first degree to the PhD level. He obtained his M.Sc., M.phil and PhD in 1998, 2000 and 2004 in Applied Mathematics.<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":0" /><ref name=":2" /><ref name=":3" />

== Career ==

In 2000, he was appointed as a Senior research assistant at the department of Mathematics at the [[Quaid-i-Azam University|Quaid-i-Azam University Islamabad]]. In 2002, he became a  lecturer at COMSATS Institute of Information Technology Abbottabad. In 2003, he became an assistant Professor the same institution. In 2005, he moved to  Quaid-i-Azam University Islamabad also as an Associate Professor and in 2011, he became an associate professor and eventually become a professor in 2015.<ref name=":2" /><ref name=":3" />

== Awards and memberships ==
In 2011, he received the Young fellow  World Academy of Sciences Award by the [[Third-World Academy of sciences|third world Academy of Sciences]], [[Italy]].  In 2012, he was elected as a member of [[Pakistan Academy of Sciences]]. In the same year, he received the Salam prize for Mathematics  by the same institution.<ref name=":2" /><ref name=":3" /> Additionally, He received the Productive scientist Awards by PCST for the years 2012–2013 in A category and in 2016 he was awarded Pakistan Academy of Sciences gold medal in Mathematics and he was eventually elected in as a member in 2019.<ref name=":3" /> In 2022, he won the [[Obada Prize]] award.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Distinguished Scientists |url=https://obadaprize.com/portfolio-types/distinguished-scientists/ |access-date=2022-06-28 |work=Obada Prize}}</ref> In 2023, he became a laureate of the [[Asian Scientist 100]] by the ''[[Asian Scientist]]''.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.asianscientist.com/as100/ |title=The Asian Scientist 100 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= |publisher= [[Asian Scientist]] |access-date= 13 March 2025 |quote= |language= }}</ref>
